title: What Amazon Quick is
hook: Natural-language chat over your data and applications, with agents that take action.

back.lead: Amazon Quick is an AI-powered service for automating tasks, analysing data, building web applications and conducting research. You interact with it through natural-language chat, and Quick uses AI agents to process your requests against connected data sources and applications.

kv.v: Quick Sight for data visualisation and business intelligence; Quick Flows for automating repetitive tasks; Quick Automate for business process automation with agents that make contextual decisions; Quick Index for grounding answers in your own documents; Quick Research for cited reports; and Apps in Amazon Quick for building web applications by describing them.
Through chat against connected sources and applications — not through a repository, a build, or code someone reviews.
This is the surface a business user reaches for. Knowing precisely what it does is the prerequisite for saying where it stops.

back.hookline: Quick is the chat-and-agents surface over your data; that framing is what makes the boundary question answerable.
